form.fieldsDesc: React Hook Form + Zod validation. FormField wires the label, error status and translated error messages. Submit directly to trigger validation.
form.modalDesc: The OK button submits the form inside. It is mounted only while open, so every open starts from a clean form.

table.title: Table (DataTable + useTable)
table.desc: Server-side paging, filtering and sorting. Local data stands in for the API here. Filters go on the left, primary actions on the right.
table.name: Name

inputs.dateDesc: DatePicker and RangePicker, localized with the app language.
inputs.stateDesc: Three sizes, plus error / warning / disabled states.

feedback.confirmDesc: Popover confirmation for destructive actions. If onConfirm returns a promise, the OK button shows a spinner.
feedback.messageDesc: Obtained via App.useApp() so it follows the theme.
feedback.modalDesc: For cases that need explicit confirmation.
feedback.modalContent: It cannot be changed after submission.
feedback.notifyDesc: Longer messages shown at the top right.
feedback.notifyContent: Details of the notification go here.
feedback.resultDesc: 403 / 404 / 500 pages. With fullPage=false it fits into the current container.

buttons.typesDesc: Common combinations of type and variant.
buttons.authDesc: Without permission the button is not rendered; use fallback to show something else. In logic, use useAuth().can().
buttons.authCan: Does the current account have system:user:add:
